# Domnina's corrected key (sources/domnina-2015-2016/p27_2016_plate_key_letter_decipherment.jpg, Ill. 1), settled from two
# blind Opus matching passes (passes/keymatch_pass{K,L}.tsv: 52 signs in 28 cells each, matched against glyphs/atlas_v2.png)
# and this runner's own look at the table. Grade AB = both passes gave this code for this cell (or the same cell for this
# code) with no competing cell; M = one pass, or both at low confidence, or settled by the runner; ? = the atlas code
# covers more than one of Domnina's cells (the atlas lumps shapes the key separates), value left open with the candidates.
# Direction matters: this is code -> value; a value with several codes is a homophone set (o: EIGHT, TWO; n: DIAMOND, HCURL).
